subject: Request: Extended payment window / quarterly invoicing — Silverpine (deal DL-2026-7831)
messages:
From: Elise Harper <e.harper@silverpinehealth.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Billing cadence and payment term request for pilot

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for a productive demo last week — the team here is excited about the pilot. Before we lock dates, procurement asked if Redwood can accommodate a quarterly invoicing cadence and an initial payment term of Net 90 for the first two quarters. Their fiscal year requires large vendors to align to quarter-end invoices, and cash is timing-constrained until mid-December.

Specific ask:
- Quarterly invoices (invoice at quarter end, payment due 90 days after invoice)
- Pilot value: $48,000 over six months
- Signed contract and SOC2 evidence provided on receipt

I know this is outside standard terms. Elise and I wanted to surface this early to avoid surprises. If you need anything from our side (PO template, procurement contact), we can provide it.

Best,
Elise
Elise Harper
Head of Procurement, Silverpine Health
Attachments: Silverpine_payment-plan-proposal_20260919.xlsx
From: camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-19T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Billing cadence and payment term request for pilot

Laura / Aditya — forwarding a vendor request for exec consent. Silverpine is asking for quarterly invoicing + Net 90 for first two quarters (pilot value $48k). They commit to signing immediately and will provide PO and SOC2 report.

Background / impact:
- Our standard is Net 30, monthly invoicing. Net 90 increases DSO and cash exposure.
- Sales recommends approving to win the account; it's a healthcare customer and a reference opportunity.
- Finance concern: extended exposure, possible bad-debt risk.

My suggested guardrails if we approve:
1) Net 90 for first two quarters only, revert to Net 30 thereafter.
2) 30% upfront payment on contract signature to offset DSO.
3) Finance to add interest clause and require DocuSign amendment + PO.
4) Legal to accept the redline MSA only with the payment schedule appendix.

Can we get exec decision ASAP so I can reply today? Attaching Silverpine's proposal and the redline they returned.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192
Attachments: SILVERPINE_MSA_redline_20260918.pdf, Silverpine_payment-plan-proposal_20260919.xlsx
From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-19T11:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Billing cadence and payment term request for pilot

Camila — I reviewed the ask and spoke with Finance (Rishi) offline. Given Silverpine's strategic fit in healthcare and the relatively small pilot ($48k), I'm comfortable granting an exception with the following conditions:

- Approve Net 90 for the first two quarters only (6 months total).
- Require 30% upfront payment at signature (to be captured on the DocuSign packet).
- Finance to draft a short amendment: interest at 1.5% monthly on overdue balances beyond Net 90 and pre-agreed escalation to collections after 120 days.
- Legal to confirm the MSA redlines are limited to payment cadence only; no changes to liability/scope.
- Approval contingent on signed SOC2 attestation and a PO from Silverpine before the pilot starts.

Rishi — please prepare the amendment language and confirm we can operationalize quarterly invoicing in billing systems. Aditya — keep sales momentum; confirm we include the 30% invoice and DocuSign flow in the proposal.

I'll sign off on the exception once Rishi confirms amendment language and Finance confirms AR process.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com
To: Elise Harper <e.harper@silverpinehealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@silverpinehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-21T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing cadence and payment term request for pilot

Hi Elise / Tom — quick update and next steps.

Executive consent granted with conditions. High level: Net 90 for the first two quarters only, 30% payment due on signature, and a short amendment to the MSA for interest and collections. Requirements before pilot start: signed amendment on DocuSign, SOC2 attestation, and PO.

What we need from Silverpine this week to proceed:
- Confirm you accept the 30% upfront invoice on signature.
- Return a signed PO to finance (scan or PDF).
- I'll route the MSA amendment via DocuSign for signatures; please sign when you receive it.

I attached the redline we reviewed and your payment proposal for reference. Once we have the signed DocuSign amendment and PO, Finance will issue the first invoice and schedule quarterly invoices thereafter.

Next steps owner: Camila (sales) to collect PO and confirm payment; Rishi (finance) to send amendment and AR instructions; Laura to finalize exec sign-off record.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
